lines.speaker: Mayor Saguaro
lines.text: My sundial! Lunch is back on schedule. Here's a seed, with the whole town's thanks.

lines.speaker: Mayor Saguaro
lines.text: Welcome to Mesa Town! I'd shake your hand, but I've lost my pocket sundial. I left it on the tallest mesa out west, past the Glider's Perch. Without it nobody knows when lunch is!
